code.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
code.why: Two-digit state and five-digit county FIPS codes. finetype has no FIPS type: a five-digit county code has a ZIP code's shape, so FIPS codes file under the general numeric code. Nominated so the label does not move with the share of two- and five-digit values in the sample.

code_display.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
code_display.why: The same values as code, nominated with it.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The two Census vintages read, such as 'ANSI 2020, Gazetteer 2026': an identifier for the snapshot. Inferred it is `unknown`.

description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: Census's name for a state or county, such as 'Autauga County' or 'Doña Ana County': free text, labelled as the other code lists label their descriptions. Inferred, finetype reads the short names as `representation.text.word`.

description_full.label: representation.text.plain_text
description_full.why: The name in context, such as 'New Mexico › Doña Ana County', labelled with description.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: The lowered, accent-stripped description_full the search reads, labelled with it.
